name: datagen
description: Start, watch, QA and tear down a Runpod dataset-collection job.

job_id.description: The id of the datagen job to supervise (dg-<name>-<n>).

steps.prompt: A new datagen sample is available for job {{job_id}}. Call datagen_sample, grade the records against prompts/qa_rubric.md, and if the bad-output rate crosses the threshold call datagen_stop to pause the job and ask a human. Otherwise record the QA result and continue. Never raise a budget or delete a volume.

Datagen job {{job_id}} has reached a terminal state. Call datagen_stop to tear down the job (serverless workers to zero or sharded Pods terminated), confirm the reaper caught any leftovers, then write a short summary of records produced, shards written, failures and spend.
